sloka: तस्य अप्रदानात् ब्रह्मर्षे युद्धम् आसीत् मया सह ।स हतो अभिमुखो राजा सुधन्वा तु मया रणे ॥१-७१-१८॥
transliteration: tasya apradānāt brahmarṣe yuddham āsīt mayā saha ।sa hato abhimukho rājā sudhanvā tu mayā raṇe ॥1-71-18॥

translations.english: O Brahmarshi when I refused, a great conflict broke out between him and me. In the encounter king Sudhanva was killed by me.
